title: Penguin SMP
description: A Fun And Exciting Economy Server.
body: PenguinSMP is a modern Minecraft economy server inspired by DonutSMP, featuring a player-driven economy, custom gameplay, balanced progression, exciting PvP, unique server features, regular updates, and an active community. Whether you're grinding for wealth, building a base, trading with other players, or competing to become the richest on the server, PenguinSMP offers a fun and rewarding survival experience with plenty to discover.
